fields.why: Table 1 gives PRMRs for 5 race/ethnicity, 6 age and 4 education groups, and MMRC preventability is tested for 3 race/ethnicity groups.
Education is SES; marital status has only 2 groups and year is not an SPD. The black vs white timing test has a 2-level SPD margin, so it makes no entry.

The race PRMRs are assessed by ratios against white women, and preventability by chi-squares of black vs white and Hispanic vs white: both per-group vs referent only. The age and education PRMRs carry no test; the flagged chi-square covers preventability by race and timing only, so side by side stands.
